acceptanceCriteria: WriteStable validates bundle map, path/digest/role closure and bounds before mutation; a traversal or mutated path cannot write outside the created bundle, and failure leaves no artifacts in the parent.

Stable bundle file reads refuse FIFO substitutions without blocking and retain regular-file/symlink identity checks before and after reads; run a reached-path substitution control with owned-process retirement.
Directory enumeration uses bounded incremental reads and refuses excessive entries before allocating the full directory.
Add stable write failure cleanup and complete refusal-result/caller-root argv tests; keep CEM-V1-060..064 traceability claims bound to their actual assertions.
body: Observed reviewing V1-0632 S5b at b08dce919185fc49b79038f93ac82c2595961fb4, range a8c05c4f45a8971665ee97d2eada7c739a0e0d14..HEAD, host go1.27.2 darwin/arm64, installed Core 1.0.0-rc.3 build 407 / Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.407. (1) stable_bundle.go:148 trusts mutable StableArtifact.Path: CollectStable a valid bundle, set first path to ../../leaked and append that artifact again. WriteStable returns publish-failed on the duplicate, removes bundle, but leaves 154 artifact bytes in parent/leaked. os.Root confines to parent, not the newly created bundle. (2) stable_bundle.go:305 opens with blocking root.Open after Lstat. Disposable overlay probe repeatedly swaps a regular file and FIFO; 2000 regular-file reads complete normally, raced helper prints READ_LOOP_ENTERED then blocks until the three-second watchdog kills it. SameFile is after the blocking open. (3) stable_bundle.go:237 uses fs.WalkDir; Go 1.27.2 rootFS.ReadDir invokes f.ReadDir(-1), allocating the whole directory before callback maxStableEntries. A huge flat directory defeats the intended resource bound. Probe source retained in /private/tmp/cem-s5b-review.Ipn6p3/probe_test.go and overlay.json. Existing receiptbundle/CLI unit packages and selected cmd/corvint export tests pass. Expected: validated exact stable closure, writes only under the new bundle, complete rollback, bounded/nonblocking admission, test refusal result equality and caller-root cases. Actual: the above two runtime probes and directory-walk source demonstrate gaps. No source repairs made.

completion.reason: S5b Codex round-1 findings fixed: WriteStable checks the exact map closure before creating anything and writes through a root on the new directory (escaping, duplicated and added path controls); entry reads use O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK with same-regular-file checks and a post-read rewalk; directory walks read in batches of 64 and refuse past the bound; refusal results are compared with verify.Stable and a CLI caller-root matrix. Codex round 8 PASS; CEM-V1-060..064 accepted under the owner's standing auto-accept (2026-10-11). Delivered in beamfall/corvint#817, merged to main at 9495d8b44. Tests on go1.27.2: receiptbundle, cem/..., lrfrepo, lrf, witness, witnesscollapse, console, conformance/ocm-v0, filtered doccorpus and cmd/corvint PASS; go vet clean; doc gates PASS; CEM check and seal PASS. full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the lane build-log record at the merge commit.

title: Stable bundle APIs permit path escape, blocking FIFO substitution and unbounded directory admission
